title: Local cohomology of a finite module vanishes above the dimension of its support, and cohomological dimension is bounded by the dimension of the ring
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the local cohomology of a finite module by the dimension of its support and the cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal by the dimension of the ring (author lemma at source lines 758-764, label lemma-cd-dimension). The proof (source lines 766-797) first reduces the second assertion to a local ring, where the complement of the closed subset is a quasi-compact open of the spectrum and hence a spectral space missing the closed point, so that the general vanishing theorem for spectral spaces applies (proof lines 767-784); the first assertion is then deduced by passing to the quotient by the annihilator of the module and using the invariance of the local cohomology under that passage (proof lines 786-796). The reduction of the first assertion to the second through the quotient by the annihilator is the content. H2.
